Sandbox_MilkIntoBarrelDurationMultiplier: Speed of the direct, no-bucket milking. 1.0 = fast, 2.0 = default (twice as long). Higher = slower. Only affects the no-bucket transfer; with a bucket the vanilla milking timing is used.
Sandbox_MilkIntoBarrelAllowNoBucket_tool: If enabled, players can milk straight into a barrel without a bucket. WARNING: milking without a bucket grants NO Husbandry XP (the real XP requires milking into a bucket first). Off by default: a bucket is required.
